stories.title: Down 0-2, the Guardians won 3 straight elimination games to take the ALDS
stories.dek: Cleveland scored 3 runs in the first 2 games, then 20 over the next 3 — including a 6-run 6th inning in Game 4.
stories.hero_stat: 3 straight elimination wins after an 0-2 deficit

stories.title: From 121 losses to 3-0 in October: the White Sox have yet to lose
stories.dek: Chicago has won all 3 of its postseason games on the road, and its bullpen has recorded 52 of the 81 outs.
stories.hero_stat: 3-0 in October, all on the road
